externalOwner.name: Pacti
externalOwner.acquisition: ephemeral PyPI install through uv --isolated --with pacti==0.3.1

observedImplementation: Harness PluginGatewayExecutionGrant constrains max_timeout_ms to 1..900000 and defaults to 300000.
Gateway execution.submit passes timeoutMs through unchanged when present.

Runtime new-admission policy rejects execution.timeoutMs above max_runtime_ms; source fallback max_runtime_ms is 900000, while live runtime.describe on 2026-09-22 observed defaultRuntimeMs=3600000 and maxRuntimeMs=86400000.

w1.conclusion: Pacti reproduces the accepted timeout seam and rejects a deliberately incompatible producer/consumer bound.

w2.topLevelRequirement: caller-granted timeout is preserved exactly through the seam and remains within the bounded accepted domain
w2.conclusion: The quotient is an obligation contract, not an invented Runtime implementation; both the 900000ms source fallback ceiling and the 86400000ms live ceiling are redundant under the tighter 300000ms caller grant and are correctly absent from the quotient.

nonClaims: This does not prove Pacti is appropriate for semantic natural-language gates.
This does not add Pacti to Ordivon production dependencies.
This does not replace Runtime owner-native admission tests.
This does not grant execution authority.
